name: compatKit
description: Named, versioned shims applied once with a host opt-out, provider registries with liveness probes and a deterministic fallback cascade, and the catalogue of taint-hostile Blizzard subsystems with their sanctioned replacements, for World of Warcraft addons.
summary: Versioned shims with a host opt-out, provider registries with a fallback cascade, and the catalogue of taint-hostile subsystems as data.
